## What looks good

- `retractHome` sets `zUp` on both retract methods. It does not set `zUp` on the G53 refusal path, which writes no lift and blocks the post with `message()`.
- Each preamble clears `zUp`. Each caller of `retractHome` is at a section boundary: `afterOp` (Go home, setup-change stop), `uprightAfterTilt` (in the preamble), `uprightAtEnd` and `onClose`. Thus `zUp` cannot stay true over cutting moves, and no later section skips its lift by mistake.
- The first section gets no lift (`secStarted > 0`). Single-tool programs do not change.
- Fanuc and Doosan: when `tcpmLeft` is true, `G49` comes before the `G28` lift. This is the same order as the Go home path. The `G90` of the preamble block ends the `G91` of the lift. In the G53 path, `uprightAfterTilt` correctly writes no `G90`.
- `tcpmLeft` is shared with #4348: `endPreamble` sets it, and the next preamble or `onClose` reads it. There is one declaration.
- The `z_homes` change in `crates/app/tests/program_entry.rs` excludes only a lift whose next line is the `G49 G80` preamble block. The trip-home count keeps its intent.
- The new tests are in the lowest crate (`camcraft-post`), in existing directory suites (`script_wcs/setup_change/`, `script_rotary/upright_after_tilt/`). Each has a provenance line. The decision record is `docs/decisions/4341-mazak-retract-before-toolchange.md`.
- Body: `Fixes #4341`, a `Changelog:` line, conventional commit subjects. `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` is not a process file, so `Process change: yes` is not necessary. No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary.

## Goldens moved (checked line by line against `upstream/main`)

The body lists all 16 files, and the diff agrees with the list:
- 14 files: only new `G91 G28 Z0` lines. Each is between the `(OPERATION: ...)` note and the `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` block of a later section. It is never on the first section. `fanuc_pause_home.nc` and `probe-face.nc` get the lift after `M0` and after a probe section. This is correct, because that stop does not lift.
- `multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc` section 3 and `indexed.nc` (2 places): the order changes to `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` / `G00 A0. ...`. There is one lift, not two.
- No other line changes. `conformance` (`every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact`) passes, so no Mazak or Doosan golden is stale.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

1. Suggested `P8` (research), and `P1` if confirmed. After a tilted section, Fanuc and Doosan write a bare `G49` before the lift. By the reason of this issue, a `G49` with no axis word can move Z on a FANUC-family control. The order is the same as before this PR, the body states it under "Not exercised", and the decision record explains the reason (a `G28` under `G43.4` can alarm). Find out whether a `G49` that cancels `G43.4` moves Z on these controls. If it does, find a lift that is legal under TCPM.
2. The same item as follow-up 1 of the review of 08:08Z: a setup-change stop after a tilted section lifts Z with `G43.4` still armed (`afterOp`, `fanuc.cps:881-887`). Main has the same code. File it one time only.
